name: Delta and Liman Coast
inspired_by: The north-western Black Sea coast as of 2026: the Danube delta with its reed marshes and channels, coastal lagoons (limans) and the flat Budjak steppe of south-west Ukraine's Odesa region, the Romanian bank of the delta, and a strip of Moldova on the north edge near a Russian-garrisoned breakaway region. Russian drones strike ports and the Danube grain route; sea mines drift; NATO's eastern flank lies across the river. All towns are fictional.
climate: Humid continental to semi-arid steppe (Koppen Dfa/BSk) with maritime influence. Summers 27-32 C, winters -2 to -6 C with occasional snow and icing on the lagoons; 400-500 mm precipitation; strong winds and fog on the coast in autumn and spring.
seasons: Winter (Dec-Feb): cold winds off the sea, fog, ice at lagoon edges, short days
Spring (Mar-May): high water in the delta, migrating birds, mud
Summer (Jun-Sep): hot, dry steppe, beach towns, vineyards and sunflowers, mosquitoes in the delta
Autumn (Oct-Nov): grape harvest, storms, fog over the reeds

vegetation: willow and poplar galleries on levees
water lilies and water chestnut in lakes
windbreak tree lines of acacia and walnut

terrain.relief: Almost flat. The delta and lagoons sit at 0-3 m with levees and sandbars; the steppe plateau rises gently to 80-150 m in the north with loess bluffs (20-40 m) above the lagoons and the river.
features: delta channels (one main navigable arm, many side channels and lakes)
coastal lagoons (limans) separated from the sea by sandbars
a river port and a sea port
the river as an international border
terrain.water: The river's main arm and distributaries, delta lakes, three limans, the sea on the south-east edge; the river is the Ukraine-Romania border on this map.

generator.approach: Heightmap at 10 m with bathymetry. Plateau from fbm in the north, dropping to the delta through a bluff step; delta built as a branching spline network on a near-flat plane with levees; lagoons as basins below sea level enclosed by sandbar splines; sea shelf gently sloping. Reed beds as a water-surface vegetation layer.

noise_layers.purpose: loess bluffs above lagoons and river

generator.erosion: Light hydraulic pass for bluff ravines; none in the delta.
generator.rivers: Main river arm as a wide spline (300-500 m) along the south-west, distributaries branching to the sea, side channels 10-60 m; water level fixed at 0.5-2 m with seasonal variation.
generator.settlement_flattening: Delta villages on levees; steppe villages on the plateau; port on reclaimed flat ground.
generator.notes: Boats and AAVs are central in the delta; roads run on levees and dams. Drone strikes on ports are frequent map events; sea mines drift along the coast (hazard for boats).

settlements.architecture: Port town on the river or a liman: 19th-century one- and two-storey limestone and plastered houses with tin roofs and courtyards, Soviet five-storey blocks, an Orthodox cathedral, grain elevators and port cranes, a market.
settlements.wall_class: Limestone shell-rock (coquina) houses medium-thick; blocks thick; port sheds thin.
layout_rules: grid of streets from the waterfront
port, elevators and rail sidings along the river
cathedral and market square in the centre

settlements.architecture: Delta fishing villages of reed-thatched and tin-roofed houses painted white and blue on levees, wooden boat landings, channels as streets (Lipovan style); steppe villages of single-storey houses with gardens and vineyards, Bulgarian- and Moldovan-style gates, a church.
layout_rules: delta villages linear along a channel with footbridges
steppe villages on a grid with gardens behind
church and shop at the centre

settlements.architecture: Agro-holding farms and wineries: steel grain sheds, silos, a winery with cellars, workers' houses.
layout_rules: on the plateau by a road; vineyards around

settlements.architecture: Military and infrastructure: Ukrainian coastal defence and air-defence sites, a ferry crossing, a Romanian-side NATO base (barracks, vehicle sheds), border posts, a grain terminal, a power substation, Moldovan border post on the north edge, the breakaway region's checkpoint beyond.
layout_rules: NATO base on the Romanian bank behind the river

infrastructure.roads: A coastal highway across lagoon dams and bridges (a long liman bridge is a chokepoint), levee roads in the delta, steppe roads; a ferry across the river to Romania.
infrastructure.rail: Single-track line to the port with a lift bridge over a liman; grain wagons.
infrastructure.power: Overhead lines, a substation, wind farms on the steppe and sandbars.
infrastructure.ports: Danube river port with grain terminals, a small sea port, fishing harbours; Romanian port across the river.
infrastructure.airfields: None on the map (AI aircraft only).
infrastructure.checkpoints: Ukrainian military checkpoints on the coastal highway and port entries; river border crossings and ferry; Moldovan border post and breakaway-region checkpoint on the north edge.

pois.description: River port grain terminal with silos, conveyors, barges at the quay, rail sidings; repeated drone-strike damage.
pois.contract_use: counter-drone defence; drone debris recovery and site security (clients ukr, rou)

pois.description: Long road and rail bridge across a liman with a lift span; damaged and repaired; the only coastal road link.
Fishing village where channels are streets; boats moored at every house; reed beds all around.
pois.contract_use: small-boat ops; counter-smuggling raid (clients mda, rou, ukr)

pois.description: Debris of a strike drone in a field on the Romanian bank; police cordon; villagers.
pois.contract_use: drone debris recovery and site security (client rou)

pois.description: Air-defence site on a bluff with radar, launcher trailers and mobile fire groups with gun trucks and searchlights.
Sea mine washed onto a sandbar near a beach town; cordon and divers' boat (game hazard).
pois.contract_use: escort EOD divers; secure the beach (clients ukr, tur, rou)

pois.description: Allied base: barracks, vehicle sheds, a helipad, air-defence battery, fences.
pois.contract_use: contract board and staging (clients fra, bel, ita)

pois.description: Checkpoint on the north edge road into a breakaway region with a Russian garrison post, flags, concrete blocks and a bridge.
pois.contract_use: counter-smuggling patrol (client mda); observe a garrison

pois.description: Winery with long underground cellars; used by a smuggling ring as a store.
Beach resort on a sandbar between the sea and a liman: wooden cabins, cafes, a road on the bar.
Ferry crossing to Romania with lorry queues, customs and a pontoon landing.
pois.contract_use: convoy escort; election-security VIP movement (client mda)

pois.description: House in a steppe village where a sabotage cell assembles drone parts; car in the yard.

weather.visibility_notes: Fog over the delta and lagoons is common at dawn and in autumn; reeds limit ground sight to a few metres but give no protection; flat steppe gives long views.
weather.dust_or_snow: Dust on steppe roads in summer; light snow some winters.

civilians.behaviour: Ports and towns busy by day; air-raid alerts at night send people to shelters; fishermen out at dawn; summer beachgoers on sandbars; farm workers in vineyards. Civilians on the Romanian and Moldovan sides live normally, with occasional drone debris incidents.
civilians.casualty_risk_notes: Port towns and beach resorts are dense; delta villages are small but on the only dry ground.

factions_present.where: Ukrainian bank: ports, coastal air defence, liman bridge, steppe villages, delta channels.
Romanian bank of the delta: border posts, a port, the allied base, debris-recovery teams.
North edge: Moldovan border post and villages near the breakaway region.
Off-map strikes (drones, missiles) on ports; a garrison post in the breakaway region on the north edge; sabotage cells; naval drones at sea.
Mine-countermeasures vessels offshore (Black Sea mine-clearing group with rou).
Allied base on the Romanian bank (French-led battlegroup type).
Contingent at the allied base on the Romanian bank.
Air policing and a contingent at the allied base.
Liaison at the allied base and a supply ship in the Romanian port (no warships in the Black Sea under the Montreux rules).
Sabotage and smuggling teams operating from the breakaway region and steppe safe houses.

frontline: No land front on the map: the war reaches it as strikes and sabotage. Russian strike events damage ports and the grain terminal (posting debris recovery, counter-drone and repair-escort contracts); sabotage cells from the north edge target bridges and rail; sea mines close beaches and channels until cleared. Romanian and Moldovan zones flip only in alert level. In the late-game escalation scenario (proposed), naval landings or a push from the north edge create a land front at the liman bridge.
contract_hooks: Counter-drone defence of the grain terminal (clients ukr, rou)
Drone debris recovery and site security on the Romanian bank (client rou)
Counter-smuggling raid on a winery cellar or delta village (clients mda, rou, ukr)
Counter-sabotage raid on a cell house in a steppe village (clients ukr, mda)
Escort EOD divers to a beached sea mine (clients ukr, rou)
Guard the liman bridge against sabotage (client ukr)
Election-security VIP movement through the ferry crossing (client mda)
Train and accompany a border unit on a delta patrol (clients rou, mda)

hot_zones.name: Steppe sabotage network (mid-late)
hot_zones.layout: pmc_kestrel and rus sabotage HQ in a winery; 3-4 safe houses as outposts; checkpoints run by friendly forces; roaming cars and drone teams; 1 QRF van group; escalation adds naval-drone attacks on the coast

insertion.fob: LHD offshore (Ukrainian or Romanian waters, proposed) for coastal contracts; inland FOB at the allied base on the Romanian bank or a Ukrainian-side port compound. Boats and AAVs are key in the delta.

early_game_notes: State-on-state strike war and sabotage (rus late, pmc_kestrel mid); mid-to-late campaign.
